## Checklist

- [ ] Branch is named `feature/<issue-number>-<slug>` (or `fix/`, `docs/`, `chore/`)

- [ ] `npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build` passes locally

- [ ] No secrets, tokens or `.env` files are included

- [ ] UI changes are keyboard-accessible, meet AA contrast and work at 360px
